text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... it won't disappear...
...I'm so thirsty... I can't sleep...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I mustn't, I really mustn't...
I have to suppress it...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Such a wretched... instinct—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Still-san. Still-san, have you ever read this book?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
..."The Crimson Castle's Vampire"?
No, this is my first time seeing it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I thought so. It is quite a niche book, after all...
However, it is a truly wonderful tale.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The delicate psychological depiction when the vampire protagonist resists his uncontrollable impulses is... Ah, no spoilers, right!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please do read it if you have the chance.
Sweep-san praised it immensely as well.
She even ended up crying near the end...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: 'To think there's not a single person who understands his feelings!' ...she said.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san is a kind soul, isn't she?
Empathizing with another's heart like that.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, though...
If it is the agony of that vampire...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Where did she...?
She was right here just a second ago...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way... Don't tell me...
Sh-She turned into mist—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...So it was you, Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAAAAAAAAH!?!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry...
For startling you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Y-YOU...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...So the one following me was you, Sweep-san.
I had been feeling an odd gaze on me lately...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, did I... do something wrong?
If so—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing! It's really nothing!
So... don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san...?
...Ah, she's already so far away...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
............
Such incredible... running...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ah...
How... how wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
The night air really is soothing, after all...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The moonlight, the stars...
They grant peace to my heart...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I must suppress this violent urge...
So I don't give in to my desires,
and drown in them completely...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Wanting to chase down that fleeing back,
and clash our raw instincts together... How could I...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
How shameful... of me...
Ah, and yet... no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I thirst—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Gasps!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...She said 'thirst', which means that's it, right?!
She really is... one of those...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: She's been keeping it a secret... all by herself...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That she's a vampire...!

With no one around to correct the little witch's misunderstanding,
the night quietly deepened...
